question.text:
The correct stability order of the following carbocations is
\(\underset{\text{I}}{\mathrm{H}_2 \stackrel{\oplus}{\mathrm{C}}-\mathrm{CH}=\mathrm{CH}-\mathrm{CH}_3}\)
\(\underset{\text{II}}{\stackrel{\oplus}{\mathrm{C}} \mathrm{H}_2-\mathrm{CH}=\mathrm{CH}-\mathrm{BMe}_2}\)
\(\underset{\text{III}}{\mathrm{H}_2 \stackrel{\oplus}{\mathrm{C}}-\mathrm{CH}=\mathrm{CH}-\mathrm{NMe}_2}\)
\(\underset{\text{Iv}}{\mathrm{H}_2 \stackrel{\oplus}{\mathrm{C}}-\mathrm{CH}=\mathrm{CH}-\mathrm{OMe}}\)

solution.text:
